FEATURES

Request handling,
routing, and file access.

01 / NETWORK

Asynchronous sessions

Beast parses HTTP messages. Asio accepts connections and handles socket I/O. Each connection keeps its own parser, buffer, and ordered response stream.

02 / CONTENT

JSON routes and static files

Define fixed responses in JSON and serve files from a chosen document root, with bounded caching and metadata checks.

03 / LIMITS

Configurable limits

Connection caps, request-size limits, and socket deadlines are part of the runtime. Set these values with command-line flags.

DEVELOPMENT BUILD

Current capabilities and limits.

Tez supports HTTP/1.x. TLS, authentication, HTTP/2, and persistent application storage are outside the current implementation.

About Tez.

Tez is my C++17 HTTP server project. It serves fixed responses from JSON configuration and static files from a chosen directory.

Implementation

Tez uses Boost.Beast for HTTP/1.x parsing and Boost.Asio for asynchronous socket I/O. Configured routes are loaded once. Static file access stays behind an explicit document root.

Socket tests exercise framing and connection behavior; component tests check routing, file access, and cache rules.

Scope and limitations

This is a development project, with no current throughput ranking or production-readiness guarantee. Filesystem reads and logging are synchronous inside I/O handlers.

TLS, authentication, per-client rate limiting, HTTP/2, and durable application storage are not implemented. The API endpoints demonstrate dispatch; they do not store resources.
